default_method: Calibrated inverse apparent size of equal-size blocks; five-frame measured camera reference.
checks: Reference geometry and invalid input guards; real YOLO camera detection; calibration and persistence; lens/zoom invalidation; no AI model download in fast mode; cancellation of slow AI; annotated image export; blue/red photos and negative background; invalid photo recovery; mobile layout; optional AI integrity, retry and camera lifecycle.
performance_scope: 20 normal frames and 20 frames under 4x Chromium CPU throttling on the cloud container. Actual iQOO Neo 6 timings are unmeasured.
accuracy_scope: Known synthetic image projection changes and mathematical scale tests only. Requires independent measurements at multiple physical distances. Rotation, occlusion and wrong-size objects can still invalidate geometry.
depth_export: Original verified AI model is unchanged and available as an optional slow method.
